statement: Every proof the gate and continuous integration perform is produced once per push cycle and read everywhere else: the fixed test lists (the safety spine and the focused contracts) are one list run once; the sealed import graph has one producer and one reader that binds the seal; every whole-tree check declares the inputs that trigger it and runs only when they changed, in the shape of the existing full-corpus triggers; ESLint covers exactly the files of the pushed range at the pushed sha; repository-health's work is coalesced into the exact-sha ci run or removed; a proof-obligation registry extending the impact-contract registry is the one place an obligation (a fixed test, a whole-tree check, a witness) is declared with its inputs; the runner size, lane parallelism and timeouts of every workflow job follow a committed execution plan rather than per-workflow literals; and the behavioural canary is activated only when the gated run did not already run the whole corpus, with ci and repository-health under concurrency groups; the budget rows duplicate_fixed_test_runs, import_graph_seal_readers_beyond_one, whole_tree_checks_without_input_trigger, eslint_off_pushed_range, repository_health_not_coalesced, workflows_without_concurrency, ci_resources_not_plan_driven and canary_after_full_corpus read zero, and every reduction cites the measurement it is compared against.

constraints.statement: Sealed only after proof-authority-integrity landed (d9819d43e); no consolidation weakens a proof that quest established: the pushed-sha identity, the observation-aware selection and the falsifiers stay green at every attempt.
No file is added under scripts/ outside scripts/quest-evidence and no workflow is added; the workflow-line and release-step budgets move down, never up.
A duplicate is removed only after the row that counts it reads the duplicate on the tree, and the removal cites that reading; a consumer never re-derives a metric its producer already wrote.
A whole-tree check runs when its declared inputs changed or on an explicit operator trigger, never on a schedule (the standing veto on timers holds).
The full-corpus canary gates nothing, keeps cancel-in-progress, and is skipped only when the gated run itself ran the whole corpus for the same sha.
Gate, selection and workflow changes land only behind an independent verification newer than the last attempt.

The single-production clause is superseded into the quest single-metric-production (owner decision 2026-09-14, recorded on this log); no reduction here removes a metric computation without that quest's digest-bound report contract.
